summary: This 8-K reports the consummation of Long Table Growth Corp.'s IPO and private placement of warrants, forming a SPAC trust. The IPO of 17,250,000 units at $10.00 per unit raised $172.5 million, and a private placement to the sponsor raised $3.6 million, with proceeds deposited into a trust account. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, restructuring) is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of an IPO closing and trust establishment.
